blocks.heading: Linear inequalities
lines: Solve like an equation, but flip the sign when you multiply or divide by a negative.

blocks.heading: Quadratic inequalities
lines: Factor, mark the roots on a number line, test one point in each part.
With a positive x² term: > 0 means outside the roots, < 0 means between them.

blocks.heading: Modulus as distance
lines: |x − a| is the distance of x from a.
|x − a| > r means x < a − r or x > a + r.
|x − 2| + |x − 9| is least when x is between 2 and 9, and the least value is 7.

blocks.heading: Counting integers
lines: Find the range first, then count. −2 ≤ x ≤ 6 has 6 − (−2) + 1 = 9 integers.
Check whether each end is included (≤) or left out (<).

blocks.heading: AM-GM
lines: For positive a and b: (a + b)/2 ≥ √(ab).
Fixed sum gives the largest product: a + b = 10 gives ab ≤ 25.
Fixed product gives the smallest sum: 4x + 9/x ≥ 2√36 = 12.
